KyberNetwork.expectedRateContract: external rate provider used by getExpectedRate

withdrawEther is protected by onlyAdmin

dest token parameter is consumed by the trade routing logic
destAddress is forwarded to the final transfer inside the trade flow
maxDestAmount caps the amounts computed by calcActualAmounts
minConversionRate is only checked against the rate in trade
trader receives refunds and defines the user cap inside trade
hint is validated (must be empty) in tradeWithHint
amount also determines the ETH quantity transferred out in withdrawEther
reserve is the external contract invoked by reserve.trade.value
expectedDestAmount is the quantity forwarded to destAddress
conversionRate is passed into the external reserve.trade call
validate flag is passed into the external reserve.trade call

sendTo is the recipient of the ETH transfer
token is the ERC20 contract invoked by token.transfer

weiAmount is a trade-local ETH equivalent used for cap checks and reserve calls
